question: What minimum off-roadway sizes does Table 9A-1 give for a STOP sign, a YIELD sign, and a Crossbuck sign on a bicycle facility?
model_answer: Direct Answer: For signs installed off roadway on bicycle facilities (i.e., on bicycle-only facilities and shared-use paths), Table 9A-1 gives a minimum size of 18 x 18 inches for the STOP (R1-1) sign, 18 x 18 x 18 inches for the YIELD (R1-2) sign, and 24 x 4.5 inches for the Grade Crossing Crossbuck (R15-1) sign. These minimum sizes apply only to signs installed specifically for bicyclist applications. Standards (mandatory): - "The minimum sign and plaque sizes for signs specific to bicycle-only facilities and shared-use paths shall be those shown in Table 9A-1. These sizes shall be used only for signs and plaques installed specifically for bicyclist applications." - For temporary traffic control on paths: "The minimum TTC sign and plaque sizes for shared-use paths shall conform to those shown in Table 9A-1." Guidance (recommended): - The Table 9A-1 excerpt accompanying Section 9A.03 confirms the off-roadway values: "Stop R1-1 9B.01 18 x 18" and "Yield R1-2 9B.01 18 x 18 x 18." Visual evidence: [Image 4] (Table 9A-1, Sheet 1 of 3) lists Stop (R1-1) with an off-roadway minimum of 18 x 18, Yield (R1-2) with 18 x 18 x 18, and Grade Crossing (Crossbuck) (R15-1) with an off-roadway minimum of 24 x 4.5 (roadway 48 x 9). [Image 3] (Figure 9B-1, Sheet 1 of 2) illustrates the STOP (R1-1) and YIELD (R1-2) signs as regulatory signs for bicycle facilities. [Image 2] (Figure 9B-1, Sheet 2 of 2) illustrates the RAILROAD CROSSING Crossbuck (R15-1) sign used on bicycle facilities. [Image 5] shows Sheet 2 of Table 9A-1, which does not contain these three rows. [Image 1] is the referenced Table 9A-1. Citations: - Table 9A-1 (p.1036) - Section 9A.02 Standard §10 (p.1048) - Section 9A.03 Guidance §3 (p.1051) - Section 6N.04 Standard §19 (p.844) - Page 1093 - Page 1094 - Page 1091
gold_answer: STOP: 18 x 18 inches; YIELD: 18 x 18 x 18 inches; Crossbuck: 24 x 4.5 inches.
